origin.details: A length-one JSON array becomes an atomic vector.
origin.value: A data frame, list, or atomic value.

translation.description: An array of objects becomes a DataFrame. Other JSON stays as dicts and lists.

arguments.name: simplify_vector
arguments.text: Build a data frame from an array of records.

arguments.name: flatten
arguments.text: Flatten nested data frames after parsing.

translation.details: Missing JSON null inside a record is NA.
translation.value: A data frame, list, or atomic value.
translation.example:
from jsonlite import fromJSON
frame = fromJSON('[{"a":1,"b":"x"},{"a":2,"b":"y"}]')
print("|".join(f"{a} {b}" for a, b in zip(frame.columns["a"], frame.columns["b"])))
